gold_review.explanation: correct_answer requires the parsed <guess> content to equal "["+answer+"]" (TextArena wants the word in square brackets). Our parser variant sent <guess>word</guess>, so correct_answer and length_bonus stayed 0 and only format_reward (0.2) was earned. Caveat: all prompts are identical (shared_prompts=1), so prompt-keyed pairing may hand out the wrong word.
